mapper.update: UPDATE device_command_record SET status = 'QUEUED', next_attempt_at = #{nextAttemptAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, error_message = #{errorMessage} WHERE command_id = #{commandId} AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE device_command_record SET attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, next_attempt_at = #{nextAttemptAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, error_message = #{errorMessage} WHERE command_id = #{commandId} AND status = 'QUEUED'
UPDATE device_command_record SET status = 'SENT', sent_at = #{sentAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, next_attempt_at = NULL, error_message = NULL WHERE command_id = #{commandId} AND status = 'QUEUED'

UPDATE device_command_record SET status = 'FAILED', error_message = #{errorMessage}, finished_at = #{finishedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, next_attempt_at = NULL WHERE command_id = #{commandId} AND status = 'QUEUED'
mapper.sql: id, command_id, device_id, product_id, command_type, identifier, params, status, call_type, source, operator_id, result, error_message, created_at, sent_at, finished_at, attempt_count, next_attempt_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM device_command_record WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND status = 'QUEUED' AND (next_attempt_at IS NULL OR next_attempt_at <= #{now,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}) ORDER BY next_attempt_at ASC, created_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM device_command_record WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND status = 'QUEUED'

SELECT c.id, c.command_id, c.device_id, c.product_id, c.command_type, c.identifier, c.params, c.status, c.call_type, c.source, c.operator_id, c.result, c.error_message, c.created_at, c.sent_at, c.finished_at, c.attempt_count, c.next_attempt_at FROM device_command_record c JOIN device d ON d.id = c.device_id AND d.deleted = 0 JOIN product p ON p.id = c.product_id AND p.status = 'ENABLED' AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE c.status = 'QUEUED' AND d.status = 'ONLINE' AND d.enabled = 1 AND (c.next_attempt_at IS NULL OR c.next_attempt_at <= #{now,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}) ORDER BY c.next_attempt_at ASC, c.created_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
